name: Dr. Hassan Ishtiyaque Ali
summary: Dr. Hassan Ishtiyaque Ali provides respiratory medicine and general medicine consultations at Dr. Hassan Ali Pulmo Clinic in Byculla, Mumbai. His qualifications are MBBS and MD in Respiratory Medicine, with 4 years of experience as of November 2026. He speaks English, Hindi and Marathi. The clinic offers OPD consultations and teleconsultations. The consultation fee is ₹300 and consulting hours are 5 PM–10 PM.
